# Single O(1) carrier gate replacing 22 redundant all-country *_fallback_pulse evaluations.
# Runs once per calendar month globally regardless of tag = BYZ or oe_start_is_1337.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_gk_carrier_tick
	}
}

oe_gk_carrier_tick = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		NOT = { global_var:oe_gk_ran_m ?= oe_gk_month_now }
	}
	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_gk_ran_m value = oe_gk_month_now }
		oe_ml_mark_start = yes
		oe_gk_monthly_dispatch = yes
		if = {
			limit = { oe_gk_is_quarter_month = yes }
			oe_gk_quarterly_dispatch = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { current_month = 1 }
			oe_gk_yearly_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
}
